applicability: Dimensional tolerance stack-up across independent contributors, worst-case and RSS methods
assumptions: contributor tolerances are independent random variables
no correlation from a shared datum, fixture or process step
uncertainty: Sanity-checked against the classic 3-4-5 right-triangle identity (sqrt(3^2+4^2)=5) before use; declared tolerances are taken as given, not measured.
limits_policy: Explicit caller-declared maximum acceptable gap, not a presumed standard.
